items.exampleEn: The front door of the shop is automatic.
items.exampleZh: 這家店的前門是自動門。

items.exampleEn: Did I spell your name correctly?
items.exampleZh: 我把你的名字拼對了嗎？
她總是穿色彩鮮豔的衣服。

items.exampleEn: I like the convenience of living near a station.
items.exampleZh: 我很喜歡住在車站附近的便利。

items.exampleEn: The cat walked silently across the room.
items.exampleZh: 那隻貓靜悄悄地走過房間。

items.exampleEn: This bag is small and convenient to carry.
items.exampleZh: 這個包包小巧，帶著很方便。

items.exampleEn: This sweater is made of wool.

items.audioEn: This hotel is convenient because the station is right next door.
items.audioZh: 這家旅館很方便，因為車站就在隔壁。
items.questionZh: 說話的人為什麼覺得這家旅館很方便？
options: It is cheap and very clean
It is close to the station

items.sentenceEn: Her room is small but colorful.
items.sentenceZh: 她的房間很小，但色彩繽紛。

items.sentenceEn: We waited silently for the news.

items.stemEn: It's cold today. Wear your ____ hat.
items.stemZh: 今天很冷，戴上你的羊毛帽吧。

items.stemEn: You don't need to bring food. It's ____.
items.stemZh: 你不用帶食物來，沒有必要。

items.passageEn: Last month, Amy moved into a small apartment in the city. It is very convenient. There is a convenience store downstairs, and the bus stop is right outside. The lights in the hall are automatic, so she never has to turn them on. Her mother gave her a colorful wool blanket for the sofa. "Now a car is unnecessary," Amy said happily.
items.passageZh: 上個月，Amy 搬進城裡的一間小公寓。那裡非常方便：樓下就有便利商店，公車站就在門外。走廊的燈是自動的，所以她從來不用自己開燈。她媽媽送她一條色彩鮮豔的羊毛毯放在沙發上。Amy 開心地說：「現在車子已經沒有必要了。」

questions.questionZh: Amy 住的公寓樓下有什麼？
Amy 為什麼說不需要車子了？

referenceEn: Is this time convenient for you?
Is this a convenient time for you?
rubricZh: 「對你方便」用 convenient for you（不寫 Are you convenient?）
用問句（例如 Is this time…?、Is this a convenient time…?）

items.instructionZh: 用 colorful 造一個句子，描述一樣色彩鮮豔的東西。
referenceEn: My sister has a colorful umbrella.
The market is full of colorful fruit.
rubricZh: colorful 可放在名詞前，也可放在 be 動詞後（例如 a colorful umbrella、The room is colorful）
主詞和動詞要搭配（例如 My sister has、The room is）
